name: enable_selected_object_color_override

stack.evidence: ScriptCommand_EnableSelectedObjectColorOverride consumes one value and passes it with the selected object to func_0013DEE8; that function sets object flag 0x4000 and initializes the render descriptor's RGBA override to (0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF, 0x80) for nonzero values or (0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF) for zero

notes: The render path copies the four override bytes only while object flag 0x4000 is set. All seven observed corpus calls pass zero.
